# Lock (masks interrupts)

Firmware lock; with d0 = 0 it sets the PSW interrupt mask to 0 until the unlock.

**Category:** function · **Address:** `0x60075f73` (runtime cached) · <span class="pill pill-beta">Corroborated</span>
{ .facts }

**Build:** [om3 firmware 1.1, build 1100](../firmware/om3-1100.md) · **Cameras:** [OM SYSTEM OM-3](../cameras/om3.md)

The unlock is at 0x60075fbc. Work done between lock and unlock runs with interrupts masked; see the hazard on keeping that window short.

## Observations

- **Static analysis** ([Caduceus for OM-3](../projects/caduceus-om3.md)): LOCK with d0 = 0 sets the PSW interrupt mask to 0. Source: [OM-3 research notebook](../sources/om3.notes.md).
- **Emulator** ([OM-Emu](../projects/om-emu.md)): Runs as stock in the lab; only its interrupt-mask half takes effect there. Source: [OM-Emu study of Caduceus OM-3](../sources/emu.caduceus-om3.md).
